title: Hippocampal astrocytic sequences emerge during learning and memory recall
title_zh: 海马星形胶质细胞序列在学习与回忆中出现
abstract: The dorsal hippocampus is a heterogeneous structure with numerous cell types involved in generating and maintaining detailed representations of space and time. Although pyramidal neurons support associative memory through sequentially active ‘time cells’, non-neuronal contributions remain poorly understood. Here we used one-photon calcium imaging to track dorsal CA1 astrocytes across days in freely moving mice during contextual fear conditioning. Foot shock evoked robust astrocytic calcium-event sequences with a time-compressed structure that resembled time-cell activity. Similar sequences re-emerged during later exposure to the conditioned context despite the absence of shock, but were not detected in a distinct context. Within the conditioned context, spontaneous astrocytic activity was associated with transitions across behavioral states, including freezing; this relationship was absent in the new context. Together, these findings suggest that astrocytes contribute to hippocampal representations of the temporal structure of associative memories and motivate further study of how diverse hippocampal cell types jointly encode experience. Senne, Suthard and colleagues show that dorsal hippocampal astrocytes display time-compressed calcium-event sequences after foot shock and upon context re-exposure, and that their spontaneous activity relates to freezing and implicates astrocytes in associative memory.
abstract_zh: 背侧海马是一个异质结构，包含许多细胞类型，参与生成和维持空间和时间细节的表征。尽管锥体神经元通过顺序活跃的‘时间细胞’支持联想记忆，但非神经元贡献尚不清楚。在此，我们使用一光子钙离子成像，追踪自由活动小鼠背侧CA1区星形胶质细胞跨天数的活动，于情境性恐惧条件化过程中。足电刺激引起星形胶质细胞钙事件序列，其时间压缩结构类似于时间细胞活动。随后在有条件情境的再次暴露中，类似序列重新出现，尽管不再有电击，但在不同情境中未检测到。在有条件情境内，星形胶质细胞的自发活动与行为状态转换（包括冻结）相关，而在新情境中此关系不存在。这些发现共同表明，星形胶质细胞有助于海马对联想记忆的时间结构表征，并激励进一步研究不同海马细胞类型如何共同编码经验。Senne、Suthard及其同事表明，背侧海马星形胶质细胞在足电刺激后以及情境再暴露时显示时间压缩的钙事件序列，其自发活动与冻结相关，并暗示星形胶质细胞在联想记忆中发挥作用。
